name: print-social-travel-agency-feed-grid
title: Travel agency feed in sky blue with swooshes and circular crops
whatItIs: A 4x3 grid of Instagram posts for a travel brand. Each uses full-bleed destination photos, a sky-blue brush swoosh, a small logo bar, and short headlines in white; some crop photos to circles or arches.
whatItMeans: Airy, aspirational and consistent; blue ties disparate destination photos together.
techniques: Use one brush-stroke swoosh in the brand blue as a signature device across all posts.
Alternate full-bleed photos with circular or arch crops for variety within a system.
Keep headline size and placement predictable for scannability.
Let a small cloud cutout blend photos with the sky palette.
bestFor: Any brand needing a cohesive photo-led feed

vocabulary.definition: The mosaic of posts on a profile page.
A painted stroke used as a brand device.
A set of layouts reused for consistency.
